tasks.spec:
python3 -u - <<'PY' > gwenv.txt 2>&1
import json, subprocess
out = subprocess.run(["aws", "ecs", "list-task-definitions", "--family-prefix", "mott-booking-gateway", "--sort", "DESC", "--max-items", "1", "--output", "json"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
if out.returncode != 0:
    print("LIST_FAILED %s" % out.stderr.strip()[:200]); raise SystemExit(1)
arns = json.loads(out.stdout).get("taskDefinitionArns") or []
if not arns:
    print("NO_TASK_DEFINITIONS for family-prefix mott-booking-gateway"); raise SystemExit(1)
arn = arns[0]
print("TASKDEF=%s" % arn.split("/")[-1])
out = subprocess.run(["aws", "ecs", "describe-task-definition", "--task-definition", arn, "--output", "json"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
if out.returncode != 0:
    print("DESCRIBE_FAILED %s" % out.stderr.strip()[:200]); raise SystemExit(1)
td = json.loads(out.stdout)["taskDefinition"]
for c in td.get("containerDefinitions", []):
    print("CONTAINER=%s IMAGE=%s" % (c.get("name"), c.get("image")))
    safe = ("ECP_LLM_INTENT", "ECP_LLM_MODEL_ID", "ECP_RAW_TEXT_DATES", "ECP_TENANT_ID", "ECP_LLM_SHADOW_SAMPLE")
    for e in c.get("environment", []) or []:
        name = e.get("name", "")
        if name in safe:
            print("ENV %s=%s" % (name, e.get("value")))
        else:
            print("ENV %s=<value-withheld>" % name)
    for s in c.get("secrets", []) or []:
        print("SECRET_REF %s" % s.get("name"))
print("PROBE_DONE")
PY
rc=$?; cat gwenv.txt; exit $rc
tasks.check: grep -q '^TASKDEF=' gwenv.txt || { echo 'FAIL: no task definition found'; head -4 gwenv.txt; exit 1; }; grep -q 'PROBE_DONE' gwenv.txt || { echo 'FAIL: probe did not finish'; exit 1; }; if grep -q 'ENV ECP_LLM_INTENT=' gwenv.txt; then echo "PASS: $(grep -m1 '^TASKDEF=' gwenv.txt); $(grep -m1 'ENV ECP_LLM_INTENT=' gwenv.txt)"; else echo "PASS-WITH-FINDING: ECP_LLM_INTENT is NOT SET in the deployed task definition (LLM intent layer defaults to off in production); $(grep -m1 '^TASKDEF=' gwenv.txt)"; fi
tasks.verified: The deployed gateway task definition read-only: revision, image tag, and the ECP_LLM_INTENT / model / raw-text-dates settings actually live in production, with all other env values withheld.
